scope: Native macOS Liquid Glass model card, opaque supplier submenu, blue/gray reasoning slider with stable per-session saves, and consistent settings corner geometry. No backend changes.
checks: 343 frontend tests passed; TypeScript, Vite build, Swift release build and signed Dev install passed (existing chunk-size/linker warnings).
Actual App fixture: one model trigger, provider-filtered model list with vision badge, reasoning footer.
End saves deepseek-flash/max once; default saves empty effort, preserving model default semantics.
Switch to deepseek-v4-pro: default/low/high stops; ArrowRight from default saves low for the new model.
Model with empty levels hides reasoning section.
390x640 dark theme: long provider-filtered list scrolls, search filters to one matching model.
Escape from slider closes popover and restores model trigger focus.
Capability read failure exposes retry; retry restores slider.
Running mode disables slider/default without issuing saves.
390x640 dark: provider switching filters models; searching demo-19 in the backup source returns one model; Escape restores trigger focus.
isolation: Only fictional in-memory API fixtures; no model calls, credentials, hosts or user settings used for browser checks.
limits: Windows native rendering and external provider APIs not exercised.
Native macOS reads and provider browsing exercised without saving the user's real model/reasoning settings; slow POST/bridge checks use fictional in-memory fixtures.
Older macOS/SDK fallback compiles conditionally but was not run on older hardware.

refinement.glass: macOS 26+ uses NSGlassEffectView.regular with transparent WKWebView content, clipped 18px corners and no WebKit focus ring. Browser/Windows/older macOS or SDK retain CSS title-glass fallback.
refinement.lowViewport: 390x400: card top 8, bottom 312, max-height 304 after live resize; ResizeObserver updates placement.
refinement.reset: Default is slider stop 0 and saves empty effort; no refresh/reset icon.
refinement.appearance: 28px system-blue selected range, neutral gray remainder, fixed supported-level dots and a white 28px thumb. Track/thumb share the window curve and lighter shadow. 240ms eased movement; direct drag; reduced motion disables transition.
refinement.sourceSwitch: Current-provider icon/name with arrow opens a side submenu. Supplier check and Manage models entry; clicking trigger again closes it. Browsing filters models without submitting selection. Native supplier menu is opaque, not Liquid Glass; web submenu uses shared AppSelect.
refinement.default: Default remains slider stop 0 with empty effort; no refresh/reset icon.

stableSaving.webCard: 276x205 for two models; stable selected/active classes and colors during slow max/high saves.
stableSaving.nativeContentCard: Transparent HTML/body, no CSS shadow/filter; retained child page serializes/coalesces slow saves without reloading model options.
stableSaving.modelRows: Same active/selected classes, text colors and row backgrounds while saving. Model submission locked without changing appearance.
stableSaving.writes: max then high; intermediate choices coalesced, one continuous busy=true/false batch, focus stays on range, no list reload or resize during save.
stableSaving.nativeWindowTests: Placement above/below anchor, visible-screen clamping, same-origin host/scheme/port rejection, hide/reopen/retained content/minimized restore/termination passed.
stableSaving.sidebar: 43 sidebar buttons: labels, disabled state, opacity, color and background identical before/during a slow save. MutationObserver recorded zero sidebar disabled/class/style changes. Reasoning busy state is tracked by session, separate from global pendingOperation.

nativeSupplierMenu.geometry: 208px width, 18px continuous outer corners, one physical-pixel border; NSScrollView.noBorder and focusRingType.none remove the double rim. Main model card remains native regular glass.
nativeSupplierMenu.interaction: Native supplier browsing exercised on macOS 26; changing browsing category kept actual selected model unchanged and main card open. Keyboard arrows/Home/End/Enter/Escape are handled by the native panel.

settingsCorners.curve: Shared --corner-window; standard round fallback when unsupported. Switches/status dots retain pill/circle geometry.
checks: Real ModelSettings component with fictional read-only providers, light 1100x720 and dark 390x720.
AppSelect popup inherits 14px outer/10px option corners; Escape closes correctly.
Inputs/ordinary buttons 10px; supplier cards/model list 14px; dialog clips contents at 22px. No horizontal viewport overflow at 390px.
Narrow supplier rail scrolls instead of hiding provider cards. Input focus uses a light focus ring, not dialog-sized shadow.
settingsCorners.agentRules: AGENTS.md: Corner geometry for frontend agents; docs/ui-guidelines.md: 设置界面的圆角比例
